items.stem: A key risk when valuing private equity holdings relative to public equities is that:

options.text: Reported valuations are stale and may understate true volatility
options.rationale: Correct: infrequent, appraisal-based pricing smooths returns and understates measured volatility.

options.text: They are marked to market every second
options.rationale: Private holdings are not continuously marked to market; that is the point.
Private equity typically carries substantial management and performance fees.

options.text: They are fully liquid at all times

items.explanation: Correct: infrequent, appraisal-based pricing smooths returns and understates measured volatility.

items.stem: Compared with a long-only equity fund, a market-neutral hedge-fund strategy primarily aims to:

options.text: Generate returns largely independent of overall market direction
options.rationale: Correct: market-neutral strategies seek return from relative value while minimising net market exposure.

options.text: Maximise beta to the equity market
options.rationale: Maximising beta is the opposite of market neutrality.

options.text: Guarantee positive returns in every period
options.rationale: No strategy guarantees positive returns each period.

options.text: Avoid the use of any derivatives
options.rationale: Market-neutral strategies often use derivatives and short positions.

items.explanation: Correct: market-neutral strategies seek return from relative value while minimising net market exposure.

items.stem: Select TWO elements that are central to operational due diligence on an alternative-investment manager.

options.text: Independent verification of the fund's valuation and administration
options.rationale: Correct: verifying valuation policy and third-party administration is core operational due diligence.

options.text: Assessment of segregation of duties and internal controls
options.rationale: Correct: reviewing controls and segregation of duties is central to operational due diligence.
Future returns cannot be guaranteed and are not part of due diligence.

options.text: Relying solely on the manager's marketing brochure
options.rationale: Marketing material alone is not adequate due diligence.
Service providers are a key focus of operational due diligence.

items.explanation: Correct: verifying valuation policy and third-party administration is core operational due diligence.
